doc.title: Håkan Rydin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016

title: Jazz and drugs; not drinking before playing
summary: Rydin says times have changed and he never drinks before performing.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: I wonder why the jazz life is connected sometimes to abuse of narcotics and all that. It’s unfortunate.

Well I don’t know so much about it. I think times have changed also. When I started to play, in my generation, it was quite a lot the opposite, you know? You were supposed to be a vegetarian and drink water and green tea and things like that. I never drink anything before I play. It doesn’t work on me. It could work on a lot of people, I mean it’s an individual choice. I don’t play that good. I think I get chancy and not in control. I can enjoy a beer after the concert, surely.
